## Bounded-scope decisions (recorded honestly)

- **Linked documents are pointers, never content.** Every
  `document_list_document` record carries the link and the reviewed
  publisher/title facts; the documents' bytes are never fetched (P8-2 —
  documents are never re-hosted).
- **A person-shaped grantee drops name-level, never row-level.** The
  Illinois award table's person-shaped row mints no subject and lands no
  claim anywhere; the recorded `document_list_rejected` row carries the
  reason + the served field names (schema vocabulary), never the name
  (Part VIII default-deny).
- **The MA capital line mints allocations, not recipients.** Per-FY rows
  are plan-level `grant_award` allocations keyed `…:fyNNNN` — the funder
  rides the recipient field as the allocating body, never an agency
  recipient guess.
- **The Ohio RFP emits no award rows by construction** — the solicitation
  serves no recipient list; the programme record carries only the
  declared facts + served window/statistic literals.
- **RB-07 seats emit facts + citations only** — `facts_citations_only`
  suppresses every verbatim `description` claim on the WSIPC and NASPO
  seats.
